# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect value counts for key categorical variables
print("\nSex distribution:")
print(trial_df['sex'].value_counts())

print("\nArm distribution:")
print(trial_df['arm'].value_counts())

print("\nSeverity distribution:")
print(trial_df['severity'].value_counts())

# Check for missing values
print("\nMissing values:")
print(trial_df.isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicates
print("\nDuplicate rows:")
print(trial_df.duplicated().sum())"}
